title: 第1516章 直接镇压第1515章 逆转突破第七境
slug: 太古封神第1516章直接镇压
lines: “就凭你这样的货色，也妄想动他？”蕴含着威严的女子声音传来，恐怖的半步大道主气息弥漫而来。
正要对秦云出手的林风海当场就被镇压了。
气息将他震慑在原地。
一名身着紫金白袍的女子撕开虚空而来，她悬空而立，双眸中散发着无尽的森冷。
林风海仅仅与女子对视了一眼，森森寒意就从脊骨直窜脑门，令他不由自主地打了个哆嗦。
见到母亲泠鸢，秦云面露诧异，还有一些惊喜，不过没有收起碧绿碎片，就怕林风海会反扑。
泠鸢悬空，漠然俯视着林风海。
“阁……阁下是谁？我乃玄铁城北源林族的族主，阁下若是杀我，玄铁城所属的余文氏族恐怕不会轻易罢休……”林风海艰难咬牙说道。
北源林族驻扎于玄铁城。
而玄铁城乃是余文氏族掌管的城池。
按照规矩，余文氏族必须得护佑北源林族。
“区区余文氏族而已，你真以为他们能护你？”
泠鸢漠然看着林风海说道：“如果真不罢休的话，那我就杀到余文氏族去，我要问问余文族主，他是不是想要和我灵音神地作对。”
“灵……灵音神地，阁下是灵音神地之人……”林风海满脸惊骇地看着泠鸢，额头渗出了豆大的冷汗。
他早就猜到泠鸢的来历不一般，但却没想到会是灵音神地之人。
“不知阁下姓名……”林风海咬着牙问道。
“泠鸢。”
林风海眼睛瞪得大大地。
他自然知道泠鸢之名。
最近灵音神地的神地之主招收了一个徒弟，天赋之高还在当年的灵汐大道主之上。
泠鸢仙子之名，早就已经传遍了古老星域。
林风海根本想不到，秦云竟然认识泠鸢，而且看泠鸢为秦云出头的模样，二人的关系看起来还颇为不一般。
“泠鸢仙子，在下有眼不识泰山，请泠鸢仙子放我和北源林族一条生路，以后我们绝对不会再得罪你们了。”林风海连忙哀求道。
泠鸢没有理会林风海，而是对一旁的秦云说道：“云儿，你想怎么处置他？”
林风海面色惨白。
如此亲昵的称呼，更是意味着泠鸢和秦云的关系非同一般了。
此时此刻。
他后悔了。
早知道秦云背后有泠鸢撑腰的话，他就不该招惹秦云。
阿蛮的话。
给他们就是了。
大不了慢慢修炼，至少能保全整个北源林族。
现在好了。
content_en:
"With a guy like you, you still want to touch him?" came the majestic female voice, and the terrifying aura of the Half-Step Dao Master filled the air.
Lin Fenghai, who was about to attack Qin Yun, was suppressed on the spot.
The breath shocked him to the spot.
A woman in purple, gold and white robes tore through the void and came. She stood suspended in the air, her eyes exuding endless coldness.
Lin Fenghai just glanced at the woman, and a deep chill ran down his spine and to his forehead, making him shiver involuntarily.
Seeing his mother Ling Yuan, Qin Yun looked surprised and a little surprised, but he did not put away the green fragments because he was afraid that Lin Fenghai would fight back.
Ling Yuan hung in the air, looking down at Lin Fenghai indifferently.
"Your Excellency... who is your Excellency? I am the leader of the Lin clan in the north of Xuantie City. If you kill me, the Yu Wen clan to which Xuantie City belongs may not give up easily..." Lin Fenghai gritted his teeth and said with difficulty.
The Beiyuan Lin Clan is stationed in Xuantie City.
Xuantie City is a city controlled by the Yu Wen clan.
According to the rules, the Yuwen clan must protect the Beiyuan Lin clan.
"It's just the Yuwen clan. Do you really think they can protect you?"
Ling Yuan looked at Lin Fenghai indifferently and said: "If you really don't give up, then I will kill the Yu Wen clan. I want to ask the leader of the Yu Wen clan if he wants to go against my spiritual land."
"Ling...Lingyin Divine Land, you are from the Lingyin Divine Land..." Lin Fenghai looked at Lingyuan with a horrified face, and a large amount of cold sweat broke out on his forehead.
He had already guessed that Ling Yuan had an unusual origin, but he did not expect that he was from Lingyin God Land.
"I don't know your name..." Lin Fenghai asked through gritted teeth.
"Ling Yuan."
Lin Fenghai's eyes widened.
He naturally knows the name of Ling Yuan.
Recently, the Lord of Lingyin Divine Land has recruited a disciple, whose talent is still higher than that of Lingxi Avenue Master.
The name of Fairy Lingyuan has long been spread throughout the ancient star field.
Lin Fenghai never expected that Qin Yun actually knew Ling Yuan, and seeing how Ling Yuan stood up for Qin Yun, the relationship between the two seemed quite unusual.
"Fairy Lingyuan, I am ignorant of Mount Tai. Please allow Fairy Lingyuan to let me and the Beiyuan Lin clan survive. We will never offend you again in the future." Lin Fenghai quickly begged.
Lingyuan ignored Lin Fenghai and said to Qin Yun beside him: "Yun'er, what do you want to do with him?"
Lin Fenghai's face turned pale.
Such an affectionate title means that the relationship between Lingyuan and Qin Yun is extraordinary.
At this moment.
He regretted it.
If he had known that Qin Yun had Ling Yuan's backing, he should not have provoked Qin Yun.
Aman's words.
Just give it to them.
At worst, if you practice slowly, you can at least save the entire Beiyuanlin clan.
It's fine now.
